name: (02) Thaumaturgy (Path of the Blood's Curse) — 1 Basic — Weight of the Sun

system.description: By winning a Mental Challenge against her target, the thaumaturge inflicts the crushing helplessness of encroaching dawn: the target gains the Negative Physical Trait Lethargic twice and cannot bid more Traits than triple his Morality (or Path) rating. This power lasts one scene and cannot affect a Kindred who has achieved Golconda. This path may only be learned by Kindred of 10th generation or weaker, and its powers only function against vampires of equal or better generation. It retests with the Occult Ability.
